scripts/graphify/bkit-graph-drift.py.name: Capability drift scan
scripts/graphify/bkit-graph-drift.py.description: Finds competing implementations and callers that bypass a capability's declared owner.

scripts/graphify/bkit-graph-eager.py.name: Import-time work scan
scripts/graphify/bkit-graph-eager.py.description: Finds files that perform work when loaded and counts the other files affected.

scripts/graphify/bkit-graph-embed.py.name: Capability diagram embedding
scripts/graphify/bkit-graph-embed.py.description: Copies the capability register's package diagram into related documentation.

scripts/graphify/bkit-graph-imports.py.name: Missing import connections
scripts/graphify/bkit-graph-imports.py.description: Resolves source imports that the initial code graph could not connect.

scripts/graphify/bkit-graph-pre-push.sh.name: Capability freshness check
scripts/graphify/bkit-graph-pre-push.sh.description: Checks that the revision being pushed produces the committed capability register.

scripts/graphify/bkit-graph-repair.py.name: Code graph repair
scripts/graphify/bkit-graph-repair.py.description: Adds resolved import connections missing from the generated code graph.

scripts/graphify/bkit-graph-surface.py.name: User-facing capability paths
scripts/graphify/bkit-graph-surface.py.description: Links user-facing requests to the underlying capabilities they reach.

scripts/graphify/bkit-graphify-graphml.p.name: Graph export
scripts/graphify/bkit-graphify-graphml.p.description: Exports the complete code graph for external diagram tools.

scripts/graphify/bkit-graphify-rollup.py.name: Capability register generation
scripts/graphify/bkit-graphify-rollup.py.description: Summarizes the code graph into package and module views and the capability register.

scripts/graphify/bkit-graphify.sh.name: Code graph commands
scripts/graphify/bkit-graphify.sh.description: Coordinates local code scanning, diagram generation and capability freshness checks.
